about.story: Frog Pond Boys started as three friends making posters for the people around them. Today the studio brings advertising, creative production and PR under one roof, with the same idea: make work people want to talk about.
about.ethos: We keep things simple, playful and honest. Every project starts with listening, gets made by the same small team from start to finish, and ends with something you are proud to show.
